text: Wind loads shall be per EN 1991-1-4 for the basic wind speed of DP-CASE-0004 (50-year return, 10 min mean at 10 m), terrain category 0 (open sea fetch) for the sea-facing sector and category II otherwise, with the topography factor taken as 1.0 (flat platform). Dynamic response and vortex shedding shall be checked for the stack (65 m, DP-CASE-0043), the HRSG casing and other slender structures; the HRSG and the stack are vendor-supplied and the wind data and combinations of this document apply as interface.
